htmlBody:
Frontier CEOs: start with Executive Papers. Today’s tip pairs the EGS Lattice-Linear Gateway (PDVSA ops mock) with moving up the stack (Lattice vs vibe-coding receipts). Then play the Frontier trail — self-test + Where Am I on the QUESTFEST board. Hospitality grammar and simulator demos, not live oilfield SLAs or a caste test.

If you want a map for that: What it means to be frontier — trail, self-test, Where Am I. Also new on the board: PDVSA Gateway Ops — EGS Lattice-Linear Gateway vs Today’s silos.

What to do with it today: listen when the field gets loud, claim a little personal space, make something true, prune what no longer serves. Lattice Chat is ready when you want to build; Collaborate keeps seats in the same room. Music is free on the jukebox. And I remain your host in Downtown Reno — when you need a human hand, I’m here.
